newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: PMH unit wins S$25.4 mln property parcel.
newsitem.headline: PMH unit wins S$25.4 mln property parcel.

text.p: Property developer Pan Malayan Holdings Ltd (PMH) said on Monday its Tat Chuan Development Pte Ltd unit had had a Singapore $25.4 million bid for four prime development sites accepted by the vendors.
PMH said in a statement the four sites at Cairnhill Circle in central Singapore gave a total of 948.9 square metres for development.
The statement said the site could be used to develop a 20-storey apartment building, but any plans would be subject to change and to approval by relevant authorities.
Funds for the deal would come from the proceeds of a three-for-two rights issue received by PMH in July 1996.
